pages.title: Fireball & Frost Bolt
pages.text: Fireball hurls a burst of flame that damages and ignites everything caught in its blast. Frost Bolt strikes a single target with a chilling hit that also slows them.

pages.title: Heal & Blink
pages.text: Heal restores your own health instantly. Blink teleports you forward along your line of sight, stopping just short of any wall in the way.

pages.title: Lightning Strike
pages.text: Calls down a bolt of lightning on your target. Inscribing extra copies of this spell adds further bolts, striking near the same point.
